messages:
ashley_support: Customer Acme Corp reports 403 when opening project console after we renamed org label this morning. They can list orgs but project UI shows 'Permission denied'. Need quick repro and workaround.

mike_cs: I reproduced in staging — project-level rolebindings still reference the old org label. @devon_idp can you check SCIM and reconciliation logs?

devon_idp: Pulling logs now. quick grep shows rolebindings applied at rename time then a reconcile that failed to map the old subject.

devon_idp: ```audit.log: 2026-03-17T15:12:34Z APPLY rolebinding project:acme-prod subject:group:acme-old-label -> role:viewer status:ok```

devon_idp: ```reconcile.log: 2026-03-17T15:12:40Z WARN resolve subject group 'acme-old-label' -> not found, skipping rewrite```

ashley_support: Customer asking for immediate access — can we add a temp mapping or manually attach the users to the project?

devon_idp: I can create a transitional SCIM alias mapping 'acme-old-label' -> 'acme' that will let the existing rolebindings resolve. Doing it for 24h now as a hotfix.

deploy-bot: SCIM alias created by devon_idp at 2911123380 (change id 7f4a). No service restart required.

mike_cs: Customer confirmed access restored, they can open the project console now. Looks like root cause: race during org-label rename left rolebinding subjects unresolved. We'll schedule a backfill.

devon_idp: Created INF-4823 with repro steps, logs, and a safe backfill plan to rewrite rolebindings after label renames. Proposed ETA for a permanent fix: EOD tomorrow.

sre_oncall: Adding an alert for future org-label rename operations if rolebinding drift > 0, and proposing a one-off migration tool to run post-rename.

ashley_support: Thanks all — I'll close the loop with the account and update the ticket once postmortem and migration plan are shipped. :thumbsup:
